mounjaro.name: Mounjaro
mounjaro.review: Medical history, medicines, pregnancy plans, pancreatitis risk, gastrointestinal disease and other factors require individual assessment.
mounjaro.newGuidance: New patients normally begin at 2.5 mg once weekly. The prescriber confirms the medicine and dose after assessment.
mounjaro.continuingGuidance: Select the Mounjaro strength you currently use. Evidence may be requested and the prescriber must confirm whether it is appropriate to continue.
mounjaro.tradeoff: An injection with gastrointestinal side effects and a gradual, clinician-led dose pathway.

wegovy-injection.name: Wegovy injection
wegovy-injection.review: Medical history, current medicines, pregnancy plans, previous GLP-1 treatment and tolerability require individual assessment.
wegovy-injection.newGuidance: New patients normally begin at 0.25 mg once weekly. Dose escalation is gradual and must be confirmed by the prescriber.
wegovy-injection.continuingGuidance: Select the Wegovy injection strength you currently use. Higher strengths are not automatic and remain subject to clinical confirmation.
wegovy-injection.tradeoff: Still an injection, with gradual titration and response that varies considerably.

wegovy-tablets.name: Wegovy tablet
wegovy-tablets.course: Once-daily tablets · pack duration to be confirmed
wegovy-tablets.review: Medical history, current medicines, pregnancy plans and ability to follow the tablet fasting instructions require individual assessment.
wegovy-tablets.newGuidance: New patients normally begin at 1.5 mg once daily. Tablets have specific fasting and administration instructions supplied by your prescribing service.
wegovy-tablets.continuingGuidance: Select the Wegovy tablet strength you currently use. The prescriber confirms continuation or escalation after clinical review.
wegovy-tablets.tradeoff: Daily dosing and specific fasting/administration instructions demand a consistent routine.

liraglutide.name: Liraglutide
liraglutide.course: Multi-dose pens · quantity varies by stage
liraglutide.review: Medical history, current medicines, pregnancy plans, pancreatitis risk and tolerability require individual assessment.
liraglutide.newGuidance: Liraglutide normally starts at 0.6 mg daily and increases gradually. A starter pen lasts longer than a pen used at the 3 mg maintenance dose.
liraglutide.continuingGuidance: Select your current daily dose and the corresponding pack. An appropriately regulated prescribing service confirms brand, quantity and continuation.
liraglutide.tradeoff: Daily injections and generally more modest average loss than newer weekly incretin options.

foundayo.name: Foundayo
foundayo.course: Once-daily tablets · pack duration to be confirmed
foundayo.review: Medical history, current medicines, pregnancy plans and individual risks require assessment by the prescriber.
foundayo.newGuidance: New patients use a staged route beginning at 0.8 mg once daily. The prescriber confirms suitability and each change.
foundayo.continuingGuidance: Select the Foundayo strength you currently use. Treatment history and evidence must be verified before continuation.
foundayo.tradeoff: A daily routine, familiar gastrointestinal GLP-1 effects and less real-world experience than established options.

orlistat.name: Orlistat
orlistat.review: Digestive conditions, medicines including anticoagulants or ciclosporin, nutritional considerations and other factors require individual assessment.
orlistat.newGuidance: Prescription orlistat is supplied as 120 mg capsules. Pack size—not a higher dose—is the purchasing choice. It is taken only as directed with appropriate meals.
orlistat.continuingGuidance: Select the pack size required. The 120 mg strength does not increase with treatment stage; the prescriber confirms suitability and quantity.
orlistat.tradeoff: Meal-linked dosing, gastrointestinal effects and more modest average weight loss than incretin treatments.
